why: Plugins are distributed as a code copy with no `npm install` step, so any declared npm dependency is
absent in the only configuration adopters actually run. For `ajv` there is no platform equivalent to
fall back to (unlike the WebSocket client, which Node provides natively since 22), so the part is
carried here instead of being asked of the adopter.
This tree is GENERATED, never hand-edited: `node scripts/sync-vendored-deps.mjs --write`.
Derived copies lag silently, so `scripts/verify-vendored-deps.cjs` asserts the tree matches this
manifest and fails the build on any divergence — including an accidental `npm install` in place.

prune.rule: Only files a runtime cannot load are removed. Every .js / .json / license file is kept, including code paths this repo never exercises — a prune list tuned to the measured require-closure would break the first adopter who takes an untested path (ajv standalone, $data refs, async schemas).

requireClosure.note: require-from-string is never loaded by the validator path (standalone codegen only) — kept anyway, per the prune rule above.
